Payments: customers, subscriptions, invoices, charges and payouts.

## API key

1. Sign in to the [Stripe dashboard](https://dashboard.stripe.com). Switch to a sandbox to try things first.
2. Open [Developers → API keys](https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys) and select **Create restricted key**.
3. Set **Read** only on what the app needs (for example Customers, Subscriptions and Charges). Leave the rest at **None**.
4. Select **Create key** and copy it (`rk_live_…`, or `rk_test_…` in a sandbox).

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add stripe
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  stripe: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Stripe's [API](https://docs.stripe.com/api) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show stripe` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** No per-call price; reads should average under 500 per transaction over 30 days, with at least 10,000 a month allowed.

**Rate limits:** 100 calls a second. Live mode, per account; sandbox 25/s; most single endpoints 25/s; Search 20/s.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Stripe).
